summary: Frontend-only testing for the 100% LOCAL/OFFLINE refactor of the DiCo/DiRi app (no backend/auth, AsyncStorage/localStorage persistence). All 12 requested flows verified on mobile viewport 390x844. App opens directly on Dashboard with create-dico-card / create-diri-card and 'Nessun documento' empty state. DiCo wizard: step0 commits via dico-committente, step1 blocks Avanti until a PLANT_TYPE is selected (verified: tapping wizard-next with 0 tipologie keeps user on step1; after selecting one plant it proceeds), step2 is passthrough, step3 shows attach-camera and attach-library buttons (not tested for upload per instructions) plus dico-luogo/dico-data and 'Genera documento' which navigates to /document/{id} with numero DICO-2026-0001. Edit flow: edit-button opens the DiCo wizard in edit mode with committente pre-filled; changing the value and tapping 'Salva modifiche' updates the document (verified new value visible in detail body + preview). Export: export-pdf-button present and clickable in detail footer. Documents tab lists the created doc and chips filter-all / filter-dico / filter-diri all respond and filter correctly. DiRi wizard: full 4-step flow produces DIRI-2026-0001 and lands on the detail. Registry: add-registry-button opens /client/new, saving a client with testID client-nome + save-client-button makes it appear in the segment-clients list; back in DiCo step0 the saved client renders as a pick-client-* pill that pre-fills committente (also populates luogo when empty). Profile: field-denominazione saves via save-company-button and persists after full page reload (verified via UI + localStorage key dico_company). PIN: toggle-pin-button -> pin-input-1 + pin-input-2 -> save-pin-button toggles the state to 'PIN attivo'; remove-pin-button restores 'PIN non impostato'. No red screens, no console errors during the flow, no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage detected.
action_items: No actionable issues. Camera/gallery upload (attach-camera / attach-library) cannot be exercised on web preview - must be validated on-device (expo-image-picker). Verified only that the buttons are rendered with correct testIDs on DiCo step3 and DiRi step3.

Minor low-priority left over from iteration_1 (uncontrolled->controlled TextInput warning in src/components/ui.tsx) was not reproduced in this run on the critical flows; still worth coalescing TextField value with '' at the component boundary when main agent has a moment.
critical_code_review_comments: Local DB layer in src/local/db.ts is clean: counters are per-year/per-tipo and persisted (DICO-YYYY-0001...); documents are not soft-deleted (hard delete) - acceptable for a single-device app.
updateDocument throws if id not found - detail screen already handles missing doc via isLoading; good.
LockProvider stores PIN via storage.secureSet (secure-store on native, localStorage fallback on web) - OK for an offline-only app.
Document detail precomputes html with foto turned to dataURI via toDataUri - good for sharing/printing offline.
No deprecated expo packages detected (uses expo-image-picker which is current). expo-image, expo-haptics, phosphor-react-native all current.
seed_data_creation: Within browser localStorage only (ephemeral per browser context): one TEST_Mario Rossi (then EDITED) DiCo DICO-2026-0001, one DiRi DIRI-2026-0001, one TEST_Cliente Uno client, one TEST_Impresa Persist company, PIN 1234 (set then removed). All isolated to the test browser session, nothing to clean up server-side.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
App is purely local (no backend). Use mobile viewport 390x844. All critical testIDs are stable: create-dico-card, create-diri-card, wizard-next, wizard-back, dico-committente, dico-luogo, dico-data, plant-*, interv-*, att-*, attach-camera, attach-library, diri-tecnico, diri-committente, diri-luogo, diri-data, basis-*, edit-button, delete-button, back-button, export-pdf-button, document-preview, filter-all/dico/diri, add-registry-button, segment-clients/installations, client-nome, save-client-button, registry-row-{id}, pick-client-{id}, pick-inst-{id}, field-denominazione, save-company-button, toggle-pin-button, pin-input-1, pin-input-2, save-pin-button, remove-pin-button, pin-key-{0..9}, pin-confirm, remove-attachment-{id}, open-settings. React Native Web renders TextField as
, so Playwright must fill the inner via '[data-testid=X] input'. Browser-automation sessions do NOT share localStorage between separate invocations - run all persistence tests inside one invocation.
